name: App.xaml.cs
description: WPF application entry point. In the Application_Startup event, it calls Startup.Execute(e.Args).
responsibilities: Keep startup orchestration outside the View

name: Startup.cs
description: Main initialization flow: single-instance mutex, culture setup, automation hooks, splash screen, MainWindow creation, and primary DataContext setup.

name: MainWindow.xaml / .cs
description: Main application shell. Defines DataTemplates for the primary screens and renders the CurrentView from MainWindowViewModel.
responsibilities: Connect the sidebar/menu to the ViewModel

name: MainWindowViewModel.cs
description: Primary ViewModel. Holds ViewsDictionary, CurrentView, MenuSelection, global commands, and overlay state.

name: ViewModelFactory.cs
description: Factory that creates and reuses primary ViewModels, connecting CaseManagerModel and CaseDesignModel to the MVVM flow.

name: CaseManagerView.xaml / .cs
description: Case management screen. Renders tabs, case properties, case builder, and actions such as export, move, duplicate, and delete.

name: CaseManagerViewModel.cs
description: Coordinates the case management screen, opened tabs, recent cases, the case tree, and manipulation commands.

name: CaseDesignView.xaml / .cs
description: Case design screen. Integrates the block list, canvas, properties panel, and visual connection components.

name: CaseDesignViewModel.cs
description: Central design ViewModel. Coordinates the canvas, available blocks, properties, opened case, and editor state.

name: CaseBuilderView.xaml / .cs
description: View for building and editing case inputs and variable groups.

name: CaseBuilderViewModel.cs
description: Case builder ViewModel connected to inputs, groups, and screening variables.

name: CasePropertiesView.xaml / .cs
description: Container View for case properties. Switches between property panels, logs, and hierarchy snapshots.

name: CasePropertiesViewModel.cs
description: Container ViewModel for case properties, integrating properties, simulation logs, and hierarchy visualization.

name: PropertiesVisualization.xaml / .cs
description: Component that visually organizes property categories such as Life of Field, OPEX, CAPEX/Drilling, and Reservoir Profiling.

name: PropertiesVisualizationViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for the property visualization panel, grouping sections and data shown in the case properties area.

name: DesignCanvas.xaml / .cs
description: Visual editor canvas. Renders CanvasBlock, ConnectionLine, and BlockConnector through DataTemplates.

name: DesignCanvasViewModel.cs
description: Main canvas ViewModel. Controls blocks, lines, history, selection, copy/paste, and the entity bound to the canvas.

name: CanvasBlock.xaml / .cs
description: Visual component for a block inside the canvas, with connectors, selection, movement, and editing interactions.

name: CanvasBlockViewModel.cs
description: Represents a canvas block, including position, entity, connectors, hierarchical children, and selection events.

name: BlockConnector.xaml / .cs
description: Visual connector component for a block. Participates in drag/drop and connection creation/removal.

name: BlockConnectorViewModel.cs
description: Logical state of a canvas connector, including parent block, offset, color, and connected lines.

name: ConnectionLine.xaml / .cs
description: Visual component for connection lines between canvas blocks/connectors.

name: ConnectionLineViewModel.cs
description: Represents a line/connection between canvas connectors.

name: BlocksContainer.xaml / .cs
description: Visual container for the blocks available to build a case.
responsibilities: Support dragging blocks into the canvas

name: BlocksContainerViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for the blocks list/container, including detachable window support.

name: CaseManagerModel.cs
description: Model responsible for case management operations, including loading, exporting, and integration with cost-related modals.

name: CaseDesignModel.cs
description: Model used by the case design area, serving data to the canvas, blocks, and properties.
responsibilities: Keep domain logic separate from UI

name: SplashScreenModel.cs
description: Manages opening and updating the SplashScreen during initialization.

name: SplashScreen.xaml / .cs
description: Initial loading screen for the application.

name: SplashScreenViewModel.cs
description: SplashScreen ViewModel that exposes status text and version information during startup.
responsibilities: Separate splash state from the View

name: ObservableViewModel.cs
description: Shared/singleton observable state object used by multiple screens and components.
responsibilities: Centralize data used by multiple ViewModels

name: ViewModelBase.cs
description: Base class for ViewModels with property-change notification support for WPF binding.

name: DelegateCommand.cs
description: ICommand implementation used to connect XAML buttons/actions to ViewModel methods.

name: OverlayController.cs
description: Controls opening and closing centralized overlays in MainWindowViewModel.

name: NotificationViewModel.cs
description: State for notifications displayed by the application.

name: RecentCasesManager.cs
description: Service for maintaining and retrieving recent case history.

name: DialogService.cs / IDialogService.cs
description: Abstraction for opening dialogs and reducing direct UI dependency inside ViewModels.

name: CanvasHelper.cs
description: Shared helper for canvas operations, including active canvas reference and support for visual interactions.

name: TreeHelper.cs
description: Helper for tree/hierarchy operations used by cases, groups, branches, and items.

name: NotificationHelper.cs
description: Helper for creating visual notifications in the application.

name: TreeObjects/*.cs
description: Tree object group: TreeItem, TreeCase, TreeGroup, TreeBranch, TreeCaseCommon, and HVModel.

name: CurrentBuildingBlock.cs
description: Data object for the currently selected/manipulated building block.

name: CustomComponents/*.xaml
description: Reusable modal and component group: CreateCase, Confirmation, CostIndex, DetachWindow, TreeSelection, NetworkSecurity, Duplicate, EditName, Branch, and Group.

name: Modal ViewModels
description: Modal ViewModel group: Confirmation, CreateCase, CostIndex, DetachWindow, TreeSelection, NetworkSecurity, Duplicate/EditName, and overlays.

name: Variable*.cs / Parent*.cs
description: ViewModel group for variables, categories, groups, single variables, parent properties, and screening input.

name: LifeOfField/OPEX/Drilling/Reservoir Views
description: Property subview group: LifeOfField, OperatingExpenses, DrillingExpenses, ReservoirProfiling, and ListProperties.

name: LifeOfField/OPEX/Drilling/Reservoir VMs
description: ViewModel group for property sections, including LifeOfField, ListProperties, DrillingExpenses, OperatingExpenses, and ReservoirProfiling.

name: ReportsView.xaml / ReportsViewModel.cs
description: Reports feature composed of its own View and ViewModel.

name: SettingsView.xaml / SettingsViewModel.cs
description: Application settings feature.
responsibilities: Connect the screen to its ViewModel

name: Resources/* + Dictionaries/*.xaml
description: Asset and XAML resource group: block images, facilities, icons, fonts, templates, colors, and styles.

name: CommandReference.cs
description: Central command reference/helper file used to organize command-related bindings and command access patterns.

name: Custom Controls
description: Reusable WPF controls used by input forms and unit-of-measure editing screens.

name: ConvertorClass.cs
description: WPF value converters used by bindings to transform values for display or interaction logic.
responsibilities: Keep formatting logic out of Views

name: LostFocusCommandBehavior.cs
description: Attached behavior that allows a command to be triggered when a control loses focus.
responsibilities: Bridge WPF focus events to MVVM commands

name: BindingProxy.cs
description: Binding proxy used to expose DataContext values across XAML scopes where normal binding inheritance does not reach.

name: IDialogService.cs
description: Dialog service contract used to abstract modal/dialog behavior from ViewModels.
responsibilities: Keep ViewModels decoupled from concrete windows

name: NetworkSecurityModel.cs
description: Model that supports the network security modal and related validation/security data.
responsibilities: Keep security state separate from UI

name: UI Helper Utilities
description: UI helper utilities for common visual behavior, tooltip handling, and automatic font sizing.

name: KeyboardHelper.cs
description: Keyboard helper used to centralize keyboard interaction behavior.

name: HighlightManager.cs
description: Utility responsible for highlight/visual emphasis behavior across UI components.

name: LogManager.cs
description: Utility for application logging and log-related operations.

name: SimulationHelper.cs
description: Helper for simulation-related operations used by simulation logs and analysis workflows.

name: SimulationLogExporter.cs
description: Exporter utility for simulation logs and related reporting outputs.

name: BulkObservableCollection.cs
description: Observable collection implementation optimized for bulk updates.

name: URLHelper.cs
description: Helper for URL opening, formatting, or navigation-related URL operations.

name: UtilityClasses.cs
description: Shared utility classes used across the application.

name: Utility.cs
description: Root-level utility file used by application startup or shared runtime flows.

name: BaseCanvasObject.cs
description: Base ViewModel/object for canvas entities such as blocks, connectors, and connection lines.

name: HistoryItemViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel representing an undo/redo or history entry in the design canvas workflow.

name: FloatingBlock.xaml / .cs
description: Floating visual block used during drag/drop or detached canvas interactions.

name: LifeOfField.xaml / .cs
description: Property section View for life-of-field inputs and related case parameters.

name: LifeOfFieldViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for life-of-field property inputs and values.

name: OperatingExpenses.xaml / .cs
description: Property section View for operating expense values and inputs.

name: OperatingExpensesViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for operating expense property data.

name: DrillingExpenses.xaml / .cs
description: Property section View for drilling/CAPEX expense inputs.

name: DrillingExpensesViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for drilling/CAPEX expense property data.

name: ReservoirProfiling.xaml / .cs
description: Property section View for reservoir profiling inputs and values.

name: ReservoirProfilingViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for reservoir profiling property data.

name: ListPropertiesViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for grouped/list-based property editing.

name: HierarchySnapshotVisualization.xaml / .cs
description: Visualization component for showing a snapshot of the case hierarchy.

name: HierarchySnapshotViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel that prepares hierarchy snapshot data for visualization.

name: SimulationLogVisualization.xaml / .cs
description: Visualization component for simulation logs inside the case properties area.

name: SimulationLogViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel that manages simulation log data and presentation state.

name: SimulationLogComponents/*.xaml
description: Simulation log overlay components such as CompanyInfoOverlay, ExportLogsOverlay, LogItemView, and SimulationLogOverlay.

name: SimulationLogOverlay.cs
description: ViewModel/controller for simulation log overlay state.

name: CompanyInfoViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for company information displayed in simulation log overlays.

name: ExportOverlayViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for export overlay state and export options.

name: LogItemViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel representing a single simulation log item.

name: LearnView.xaml / LearnViewModel.cs
description: Learning/help feature composed of a View and ViewModel.

name: LicenseView.xaml / LicenseViewModel.cs
description: License feature composed of a View and ViewModel.

name: OutputAnalysisView.xaml / OutputAnalysisViewModel.cs
description: Output analysis feature composed of its own View and ViewModel.

name: SupportView.xaml / SupportViewModel.cs
description: Support/helpdesk feature composed of its own View and ViewModel.

name: ReservoirProfile.xaml / .cs
description: Standalone reservoir profile View used by reservoir-related workflows.

name: UtilityControl.xaml / .cs
description: Utility control View used by shared or supporting UI workflows.

name: WpfViewHelper.cs
description: View helper utilities specific to WPF visual tree or View operations.

name: ScreeningInputViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for screening input data used by the case builder.

name: TabViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel representing an opened case tab in the case manager.

name: CostIndexModalViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for the cost index modal used by case management workflows.

name: DetachWindowViewModel.cs
description: ViewModel for detachable/floating window behavior.
responsibilities: Support moving components outside the main shell

name: ReactiveModelBase.cs
description: Base reactive model class used by ViewModels or model wrappers.

name: WrapperBase.cs
description: Base wrapper class used to expose model data safely to the ViewModel/UI layer.

name: Parent/Variable ViewModels
description: Detailed variable hierarchy ViewModels, including parent properties, parent screening, parent variable, variable category, variable group, and variable item ViewModels.

name: DummySingleVariableViewModel.cs
description: Dummy/specialized single-variable ViewModel used where a placeholder or simplified variable is required.

name: Project Properties
description: Generated project property files such as AssemblyInfo, Resources, and Settings.
